method: Each definition in s14-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration test runs the real public route handlers as envoi_web on a local PostgreSQL database built from the migrations, with DATABASE_URL removed, holding the seeded demo FIXTURE shop and one confirmed but unpublished FIXTURE shop. The unit test checks the contract validator on hand-built responses. Every definition here is an S14 test recorded in 00-status.md.
